# mygo-ui-sdk llms.txt

Index of guides for building accessible, agent-ready Go Native UI on github.com/egoist/mygo/ui.

## References
- references/bases-and-roles.md — Choosing between MyGo ui.*Base controls, behaviors.*, and ARIA roles.
- references/behaviors.md — API guide for behaviors: TrackDrag, SwitchTrack, SegmentedTrack, SegmentedGroup, Toolbar, NavList, RadioGroup, PlaceFloating, ShouldDismiss.
- references/state-and-keys.md — Immediate-mode rules: Context.Key, ui.Local + io.Closer, Handle, FocusBind, and animation frame scheduling.
- references/testing-and-a11y.md — Testing with ui.Tester and uitest (Audit, AssertAgentReady, AssertThemeParity, AssertDirectionParity, AssertRovingFocus).

## Go packages
- github.com/Lumiaqian/mygo-ui-sdk/behaviors — Composable immediate-mode interaction behaviors.
- github.com/Lumiaqian/mygo-ui-sdk/uitest — Accessibility, keyboard, RTL/theme, and agent-readiness conformance assertions.
